mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 230 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) reading below 800 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 800, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the previous month signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly job growth rate exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has declined for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
